questions.question: Why is cutting 7 1/2 m of fabric into 3/4 m pieces a division problem, and how many pieces result?
questions.expected_answer: It asks how many three-quarter pieces fit into seven and a half, which is grouping, so divide: 15/2 × 4/3 = 10 pieces.

questions.question: From R600, a third is spent and then a quarter of the remainder. Explain the common error and give the correct amount left.
questions.expected_answer: The error is taking a quarter of the original R600. A third of 600 is 200, leaving 400; a quarter of 400 is 100; R300 is left.

questions.question: Three fifths of a number is 24. Explain how to find the number.
questions.expected_answer: Three equal parts make 24, so one part is 8; five parts make 40. Check: three fifths of 40 is 24.
